meta.title: NFL Insights source register
meta.scope: nfl-insights/ only; every URL below was opened and read via the page-fetch tool on 2026-11-12 unless noted.
meta.policy: Only official / first-party sources are used: the NFL and its official properties, licensed-sportsbook official help pages, state gaming regulators, NIST (US government statistics), Princeton University (hosting the original Kelly paper), Kaggle (official competition platform), NOAA/NWS. Third-party blogs are NOT used as sources; anything that could only be found there is left blank and listed in flagged.json.

sources.label: NFL.com — Official NFL Injury Report (Week 10, 2026 snapshot)
sources.note: Week 10 official injury report read on 2026-11-12. Shows player, position, injury, practice status (DNP/Limited/Full) and game status (Questionable/Doubtful/Out). Dynamic page — values change weekly; snapshot is as-of stamped and never treated as permanent truth.

sources.label: NFL.com — Injury report policy (practice / game status definitions)
sources.note: Defines practice report (Did Not Participate / Limited / Full) and game status report (Questionable = uncertain; Doubtful = unlikely to play; Out = will not play).

sources.label: NFL.com — Official team roster (Green Bay Packers example)
sources.note: Official roster page. The NFL does NOT publish depth-chart ordering (1st/2nd/3rd/4th string) on this page; the roster is alphabetical by last name. Backup-depth claims are therefore left blank and flagged, never inferred.

sources.label: NFL.com — Official directory of all 32 teams
sources.note: Lists all 32 clubs across NFC/AFC with links to each team's official website.

sources.label: NFL.com — Official 2026 regular-season standings
sources.note: Dynamic page; snapshot as of 2026-11-12 (through Week 10). Re-pull for current values.

sources.label: NFL Media — 2026 NFL Schedule Announced (May 14, 2026)
sources.note: 18-week, 272-game 2026 regular season; each team plays 17 regular-season + 3 preseason games; kickoff Wed Sept 9, 2026; Week 18 Jan 9-10, 2027; 14-team playoff (7 per conference).

sources.label: DraftKings — official help: what is a parlay bet
sources.note: Defines a parlay as combining two or more single wagers into one bet; all selections must win; push leg handling and correlated-selection restrictions noted.

sources.label: DraftKings — official help: what is a prop bet
sources.note: Defines a prop bet as a wager on an individual player or specific event not directly connected to the game outcome.

sources.label: DraftKings — official glossary of betting terms
sources.note: Defines point spread, moneyline, over/under, teaser, push handling.

sources.label: State of Nevada — Gaming Control Board Regulation 22
sources.note: Requires sports-pool wager outcomes to be confirmable from official public records of the league/governing body or its designated statistics provider.

sources.label: NOAA National Weather Service — point forecast
sources.note: Point forecast (7-day + hourly). Use stadium lat/lon for outdoor-game weather inputs.

sources.label: Kelly (1956) — A New Interpretation of Information Rate
sources.org: Princeton University (hosting original Bell Labs paper)
sources.note: Original staking/growth paper; cited for context only, not as an NFL strategy endorsement.

sources.label: NIST — Correlation coefficient (Pearson r) reference
sources.note: Defines how correlation values are determined; cited for method context only.

sources.label: NIST/SEMATECH e-Handbook — Bonferroni multiple-comparisons adjustment
sources.note: Multiple-comparisons control method; cited for validation-gate method context only.

sources.label: Kaggle — NFL Big Data Bowl 2027
sources.note: Leaderboard competition model referenced for reward-tier design; no prize pool is funded in this project.

sources.label: NFL — Big Data Bowl announcement
sources.note: NFL Big Data Bowl program overview; cited as the competition model reference.
